rationale: MGNI gapped up ~13% on strong earnings and has already run significantly from the open high of $28.17, now sitting at $27.39 with the 9-EMA above at $27.62 — price is below its short-term moving average in a choppy, low-momentum consolidation (last 5 candles show tight range with declining volume).
